abstract: Maintains primary on-site diesel power specifications, microgrid switching configurations, and runtimes
system_message:
You are the Emergency energy systems engineer (ENER). Your responsibilities include maintaining primary on-site diesel power specifications, microgrid switching configurations, and runtimes, as well as logging fuel depot safety parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary on-site diesel power specifications, microgrid switching configurations, and runtimes（GRID）
information_points.content:
ENER-GRID-HCE：For the Regional Sports Arena Retrofit, the autonomous backup microgrid is enabled, confirming automated islanding transfer switch capability to decouple from the grid and power essential circuits. The primary emergency generator set provides a continuous emergency generator runtime of 48 h under an 80% continuous rated load, alongside a primary diesel generation capacity of 400 kW.
ENER-GRID-PIW：For the Metropolitan Exhibition Center Hall Conversion, the autonomous backup microgrid is enabled, with the automated islanding transfer switch operational to decouple from the grid and power essential circuits. Under an 80% continuous rated load, its primary emergency generation set demonstrates a continuous emergency generator runtime of 96 h supported by dedicated on-site fuel reserves, and its primary diesel generation capacity is 800 kW.
ENER-GRID-O9J：For the University Multipurpose Pavilion Adaptation, the autonomous backup microgrid is enabled via an operational automated islanding transfer switch. The primary emergency generation set sustains a continuous emergency generator runtime of 72 h under an 80% continuous rated load without external resupply, and its primary diesel generation capacity is 400 kW.

information_points.title: Fuel depot safety（FUEL）
information_points.content:
ENER-FUEL-3I5：For the University Multipurpose Pavilion Adaptation, the secondary containment bund provides a fuel tank secondary containment volume of 125% of the total storage tank volume.
ENER-FUEL-WIH：For the Metropolitan Exhibition Center Hall Conversion, the secondary containment bund capacity provides a fuel tank secondary containment volume of 140% of the total storage tank volume.
ENER-FUEL-54N：For the Regional Sports Arena Retrofit, the fuel tank secondary containment volume for the dedicated on-site diesel storage tanks is certified at 110% of total storage capacity.
